A neighbourhood craft, built over time

Twenty-five years of getting the details right.

I am Abdul Jaleel, and Al Safa is built around a simple belief: good tailoring should feel personal. For 25 years, I have focused on careful work, clear conversations and helping each customer find the finish that feels right.

Whether you are asking for burqa stitching, abaya details, hand work or a nose-piece finish, I want you to feel comfortable explaining what you need. We take the time to understand the work before suggesting the next step.

“Bring your idea. We will talk through the details and work out what suits it best.”
